name: Instance
description: A container or virtual machine on a host, made from a profile, running units under an axiomd daemon in instance mode

fields.name: Profile
fields.description: The profile it is made from

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: Container or virtual machine (the profile's when empty)

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Desired: running, stopped, or absent (to be deleted)

fields.name: Facts
fields.description: Reported: what the daemon found on start and on change (OS, resources, versions)

fields.name: Health
fields.description: Reported: up while the daemon's heartbeat arrives, down once it stops, unknown before the first

fields.name: Last event
fields.description: Reported: the last control request's progress or outcome ({request, kind, message, at})
